_ajuda.pasta_projetos: Folder with your clones, organized by language. E.g. D:\PROJETOS (Windows) or ~/projetos (Linux/macOS). On Windows use double backslashes
_ajuda.pasta_dados: Where revisao.json, historico.json and relatorios/ are stored. Relative = inside the project folder. Point it to a synced folder (Google Drive, OneDrive...) for backup
_ajuda.anos_parado: Repositories without a push for longer than this (in years) are highlighted
_ajuda.permitir_excluir: false = Delete button hidden and blocked on the server. Deleting CANNOT be undone
_ajuda.incluir_organizacoes: true = also list repositories from organizations you belong to
_ajuda.abrir_navegador: true = open the browser automatically when the server starts
_ajuda.idioma: Interface language on first open: en or pt-BR (the page remembers your choice afterwards)
_ajuda.pasta_sem_linguagem: Folder used for repositories with no detected language
_ajuda.apelidos: GitHub language -> folder name. Languages not listed become lowercase (Python -> python)
